impact: T-007's 'Current state' section and pre-publish gates describe work already completed and cite a line range that has moved: the attribution test is at packaging.contract.mjs:261-270 not :111-119; the recorded 'greps only package.json' blind spot is closed by the content-wide scan at :225; gate 1's real Codex rollout ID is no longer in src/ (src/codex.ts:52 carries the synthetic convention); gate 2's USER=amirshayegh / real home path no longer appear in src/. Risk is specific to a publish checklist: gates that are already met invite the executor to discount the list, and the 'no autonomous publish' hard rule sits at the top of the same description. Filed as ISS-037 rather than fixed inline because T-007 is a different ticket.
resolution:
Duplicate of ISS-037 — same finding, filed twice by me. ISS-037 is the one to keep: it carries the file locations, related tickets, and a dedupeKey.

Cause, recorded because this is the SECOND occurrence (ISS-034 was the first, on 2026-07-31): reporting a review finding with disposition "deferred" AUTO-FILES an issue. I filed ISS-037 by hand and also reported the same finding as deferred, producing this duplicate. The correct pattern is one or the other, never both — either report it "deferred" and let the guide file it, or file it by hand with full metadata and report the finding as "addressed"/"open" with a note naming the issue ID.

Repeating this after having written the ISS-034 explanation is an instance of the defect this ticket keeps surfacing: recording a lesson is not the same as changing the behaviour it describes.
